objective: Map the public package, deterministic dry-run lifecycle, and metadata-frozen natural-project pilot preparation without treating selection or annotation-packet readiness as empirical reliability evidence.

elements.target: Source drift or same-ID semantic conflict emits candidate/delta evidence while preserving the accepted map.
A missing accepted map produces only a provisional candidate and an append-only history event.
The documented observation template preserves declared evidence locators when passed through reconciliation.
Candidate acceptance enforces every required field in the published component-map schema.
An unchanged accepted map is checked and reused without a replacement candidate or delta.
Every mapped element has nonempty evidence, and any test-backed element also names a direct non-test dependency.

evidence.locator: Build or reconcile the component-to-element map

elements.target: The workspace GitHub wrapper and Downloads mirror remain synchronized after append-only audits.

evidence.locator: public wrapper content and evaluation references

elements.target: Skill metadata and referenced resources in staging, export, Downloads, and installed copies.
Active RAG claim, lifecycle, audit-independence, and paper-table boundaries remain internally consistent after the skill change.

evidence.locator: bounded lifecycle and audit-independence result claims

elements.target: README distinguishes deterministic behavior evidence from cross-project reliability and general RAG benefit.

evidence.locator: Research status and Paper-facing evaluation plan

elements.target: General reliability across projects, agents, models, and domains.
Final authorship, repository URL, DOI, and author-approved software license.
Current and historical self-scan inputs have unambiguous authority and lifecycle labels.
The README repository tree represents the current validation artifacts introduced by v0.2.0.

evidence.locator: Repository layout and validation authority paragraph

elements.target: Element-level evidence method, check status, claim status, interpretation, and repair are persisted hierarchically.
The expanded package does not break active repository contracts.

evidence.locator: selection, snapshot, annotation-packet, and execution-gate contracts
public human-label schema and codebook regressions

elements.target: Prepared agent packets exclude gold labels, fixture plans, adjudications, and prior condition outputs.
Every declared project-condition-agent-family-repeat cell is required and missing submissions fail closed.
Finding, element, severe-recall, false-positive, repair, provenance, time, and token metrics are aggregated with project as the primary independent unit.
Runner completion, audit completion, scientific support, and paper acceptance remain separate, and the scripted dry run cannot authorize reliability.
Development and confirmatory templates require natural projects, multiple live agent families, independent labels, project-level analysis, and frozen claim boundaries.

A project with zero adjudicated gold findings remains valid: undefined detection metrics and matched deltas remain null and are excluded from macro means, while submitted false positives and false-positive element rate remain penalized.

evidence.locator: empty-gold acceptance, false-positive penalty, and undefined-delta regressions

elements.target: A diverse 4-6-project natural sample is bound to exact repositories and commits before inconsistency outcomes are inspected.

evidence.locator: sampling_rule and four pinned project identities
selection diversity and outcome-known rejection tests

elements.target: Every natural snapshot has commit-bound acquisition and license hashes, respects frozen size caps, and remains outside the public distribution.

evidence.locator: commit, archive, and license hash contract
public-tree rejection and snapshot validation paths

elements.target: Two human annotator slots receive snapshot-identical packets that exclude condition prompts, agent outputs, gold labels, and the other annotator's labels.
Agent execution remains blocked until independent labels, blinded adjudicated gold, and two exact live agent/model families exist; preparation cannot authorize scientific or paper claims.

evidence.locator: V2 partial experiment without completion, scientific, or acceptance evidence

elements.target: The controller freezes human evidence only after exact project-slot coverage, distinct stable human identities, selection and snapshot binding, blinded third-human adjudication, source-candidate validation, and raw/gold hash verification; forged summaries and post-freeze tampering fail closed.

evidence.locator: roles, component-to-element units, finding semantics, operator definition, and file workflow
completed annotation identity, snapshot, attestation, element, and finding contract
third-human adjudication and source annotation hash contract
frozen label-set and SHA-256 commitment contract
coverage, forged-summary, successful freeze, and post-freeze tamper regressions
